ILMN.thesis_one_line: Leading DNA-sequencing machine maker whose sales are genuinely re-accelerating, but the share price already assumes about 20% yearly cash growth for five years.
kill_criteria: Revenue excluding China and acquisitions grows less than 4% for two consecutive quarters (Q2'26 was 8.1%).
Non-GAAP gross margin below 67% for two consecutive quarters (Q2'26: 68.2%).
FY26 non-GAAP EPS guidance midpoint cut below $5.15 (current range $5.30-$5.40).
Consolidated net debt/TTM EBITDA above 2.0x (currently about 0.7x).
Adverse ruling or accrual above $250m in GRAIL-related litigation (none quantified in the 10-Q).
key_adverse_facts: Price $270 is about 50x FY26 non-GAAP EPS with a 2.0% FCF yield (1.6% after stock comp)
Non-GAAP gross margin fell 120bp YoY in Q2'26 (69.4% to 68.2%); memory-chip and energy costs expected to continue
Greater China revenue $56m vs $63m in Q2'26; on China's Unreliable Entities List
Reporting owner Keith A. Meister sold about 3.06m shares (about $591m) since 2026-03-25 per Form 4s
GRAIL-related Delaware derivative suits open; Q2'26 FCF down 21% YoY
data_conflicts: d4 FCF $798m vs filings TTM OCF $1,095m less capex about $163m = about $932m
d4 total debt $2.53bn includes operating leases vs $1.99bn carrying term debt
Q2'26 non-GAAP EPS ($1.31) is below GAAP ($1.35) because of strategic investment gains
ILMN.confidence_in_thesis: medium: operating acceleration is well evidenced in filings, but the valuation conclusion depends on discount-rate and growth assumptions

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies 19.8% yearly FCF growth for five years (26.2% after stock comp) versus my 12% base; agrees with triage that price is ahead of fundamentals.

ILMN.scenario_basis: Start $270, FY26 non-GAAP EPS $5.35, no dividend; bear EPS $6.0 x 20x, base EPS $7.5 (12% CAGR) x 28x, bull EPS $8.8 (18% CAGR) x 35x over 3 years.

TSN.thesis_one_line: Chicken and prepared-foods profits and a 4% dividend are priced as if nothing grows, while beef losses and antitrust suits are the named risks.
kill_criteria: Fiscal-year adjusted operating income guidance midpoint cut below $2.0bn, or FY26 actual adjusted operating income below $2.1bn.
Consolidated net debt/Adjusted EBITDA (company Ratio Calculations table) above 2.75x (currently 2.1x).
Chicken adjusted segment operating margin below 8% for two consecutive quarters (nine-month FY26: 11.4%).
Aggregate new antitrust settlements/accruals above $500m beyond the $437m accrued at 2026-06-27 (broiler $139m, pork $83m, beef $215m).
key_adverse_facts: FY26 adjusted operating income guidance cut on 2026-08-03 to $2.1-2.3bn from $2.2-2.4bn, entirely from beef
Open broiler, pork and beef antitrust matters plus DOJ civil investigative demands; beef class certification partly granted 2026-07-16
CEO and COO replaced in Q3 FY26; $73m transition charge
GAAP EPS ($1.49 nine months) far below adjusted ($2.83); legal accruals recur
Net debt $7.27bn consolidated; net debt/EBITDA 2.8x, net debt/Adjusted EBITDA 2.1x
data_conflicts: d4 EBITDA $2.77bn (GAAP) vs company TTM Adjusted EBITDA $3.53bn
d4 trailing EPS $1.62 is GAAP while FY26 consensus $3.71 is adjusted
d4 sharesOutstanding 281.8m is Class A only; market cap reflects about 352m shares
TSN.confidence_in_thesis: medium: low implied growth gives a cushion, but beef cycle timing and litigation size are uncertain

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies 1.1% yearly FCF growth versus my 6% base; triage called it a cycle call, which I accept, but the price already discounts a weak cycle.

TSN.scenario_basis: Start $50.92, FY26 adjusted EPS about $3.8, dividend $2.04 a year; bear EPS $3.0 x 10x, base EPS $4.9 x 13x, bull EPS $6.0 x 14x in year 3, plus 3 years of dividends.

MTD.thesis_one_line: Best-in-class lab and industrial weighing-instrument maker with steady beat-and-raise results, but the price already assumes faster growth than guidance supports.
kill_criteria: Local-currency sales growth excluding acquisitions below 2% for two consecutive quarters (Q2'26: +4% underlying excluding the tariff refund).
Full-year adjusted EPS guidance midpoint cut below $46.30 (current $47.15-$47.50).
Adjusted operating margin below 27% for two consecutive quarters (Q2'26: 30.1%).
key_adverse_facts: NTM P/E 29.9x with FCF yield 2.9% on $30.3bn market cap
Q2'26 GAAP EPS includes $52.4m one-time IEEPA tariff refund benefit partly offset by $27.8m customer refunds
Shareholders' equity only $12.8m after $10.3bn cumulative buybacks; buybacks partly debt-funded
Officer/director sales about $6.1m since 2026-03-25; no purchases
data_conflicts: d4 FCF $694m vs filings TTM OCF about $975m less capex about $111m = about $864m
b1 ROE and leverage percentiles reflect near-zero book equity, not extra quality
MTD.confidence_in_thesis: medium: business quality and guidance track record are well evidenced; valuation view is sensitive to cost of equity

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies 14.0% yearly FCF growth versus my 9% base; triage reached WATCH-like conclusion on valuation and I confirm it.

MTD.scenario_basis: Start $1,511.64, FY26 adjusted EPS $47.3, no dividend; bear EPS $54 x 22x, base EPS $62 x 28x, bull EPS $68 x 32x in year 3.
